freeze.scope: Current continuous science controls, explicit frozen spectral indices; physical-r and full NSC states/errors replayed before ablation. No source selected by PM or favourable new result. Existing ordinary/repeated C cores are explanatory diagnostics, not new blind validation. Every extra member is non-r NSC and SDSS/r members stay fixed.

time.scope: Identical frozen source/r/SDSS detections and unchanged C0/W0. A r; B adds all other-band measurements on nights without NSC r; C adds other bands on original r nights. B1 uses the first physical exposure on each new night, not a result-selected exposure. Seasons use the C union and 90day gaps. Time information/leverage is conditional diagonal W0 information, not proof of independent nightly errors. Full reference 4x4 covariance retained. Formal-error pass counts describe this fixed QSO sample, not catalogue yield.

bands.scope: Identical frozen QSO/r/SDSS members and reference graph. Band deletions evaluated only on the same covered source subset, never comparing different successes. Every available NSC band diagnosed without a name whitelist. NSC-only/first-SDSS/all-SDSS use exactly the same NSC measurements. No formal-error postselection; these are conditional known-position controls, not blind purity or causal atmospheric estimates.
